prerequisites: No prerequisites. Recommended are the competencies taught in the modules Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or Introduction to Natural Language Processing.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can name basic functions and components of language systems and compare them in the context of various application scenarios.
Students can describe architectures for language systems.
Students can independently develop simple language systems.
Students can analyze the possible implications of using language systems.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire ECTS, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination is either an oral examination or a written exam.
